notes.title: Progress Update - New Weapons
notes.notes:
Progress Update
Hey, welcome back to another update. Been a little while since the last update since I have been a little busy, however that doesn't mean progress has stopped! I am now working on adding more weapons to the game, as it currently lacks this at the moment. I am also working on making bosses to be spawn-able through items, which are craft-able through the resources you find in the world.



There is still a lot of work to be done but hopefully early access won't be too far off. The demo lets you play the game in its beta form, so that won't be going away! Also with next fest around the corner, trying to get most features done for the next demo update is key :)

New combat code which replaces old combat system
